title: What Is Around You?
goal: By the end of this lesson, you can describe your home, office, and neighborhood using There is/There are. You can distinguish This is (identify) from There is (exist), and use linking and reduction naturally.

examples.text: There is a small balcony in the apartment.
My office has a balcony.

items.def: a machine that takes you up and down

examples.text: Is there an elevator in your building?
The elevator is on the left.
There are two meeting rooms in the office.
I booked a meeting room.

items.def: a small shop for everyday items

examples.text: There is a convenience store downstairs.
I bought coffee at the convenience store.
There are two bedrooms in my apartment.
My office has two bedrooms for guests.
There are some small shops downstairs.
There are some small shops near the office.
There are many trees in this area.
There are many trees outside the office.
There are several cafés nearby.
There are several cafés near the office.
Is there a supermarket near your place?
There is a supermarket across from the building.
There is a park near my house.
There is a park outside the office.

vocab.text: Choose two people. Say who they are and one thing you like or dislike about them. Accept simple language — ask one follow-up: How do you know them? or What are they like?

grammar.text: There is vs There are — existence map
This is vs There is — two different jobs

head: Question
Answer
Use
rows: Say what exists in a place
Yes, it is. This is a café.

grammar.text: Yes-No question engine — flip is/are to the front

head: Statement
Question
Answer
rows: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.

grammar.text: SOME in statements · ANY is common in questions. There's a café. → Is there a café?

reading.text: This is my new workplace. Our small sales team works on the second floor. That woman near the window is my manager, Anna. Her desk is beside those blue cabinets. These two laptops belong to our new employees. My favorite place is the little coffee corner near the meeting room. Our morning meetings usually start there.
Notice: There is/There are + thing + place. The place comes after the thing.

conversations.title: A café near home
conversations.lift: THERE questions describe the place · IT questions describe the thing

lines.speaker: B

conversations.title: My neighborhood
conversations.target: There's a… · There are… · There isn't…

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What's around your building?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There's a small café across from my apartment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are there any shops?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: There are two convenience stores within walking distance.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is there a supermarket nearby?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. There isn't a supermarket nearby.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is there a park?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. There's also a park behind my building.

conversations.answers: 1. Yes, across from the apartment. 2. No. 3. Behind the building.
conversations.note: There's = there is. Stress the THING: café, stores, park.

listening.text: Shadowing · Nghe từng câu rồi nhắc lại
Bấm 🔊 để nghe từng câu, sau đó nhắc lại y hệt ngữ điệu. Làm 2 lượt: lượt 1 nhìn chữ, lượt 2 che chữ.

exercises.text: Bài tập 1 · Chọn There is hay There are
Đáp án: 1 There is · 2 There are · 3 There is · 4 There are. Quy tắc: one thing → is, more than one → are.

items.q: There are two meeting rooms. → Question?
There are some cafés nearby. → Question?

exercises.text: Đáp án: 1 Is there a balcony? 2 Are there two meeting rooms? 3 Are there any cafés nearby? Quy tắc: đảo is/are lên trước there. SOME → ANY in questions.

speaking.text: Work with a partner. Ask 5 Yes-No questions about your home, office, or neighborhood. Use Is there…? / Are there…? Answer with full messages.

items: Is there a balcony in your apartment?
Is there a supermarket near your place?
Are there any meeting rooms in your office?
There is a small balcony in the apartment.
There are two cafés across the street.

speaking.text: Use: Is there…? / Are there…? Answer with Yes, there is. / Yes, there are. + full message.

roleplay.title: Guided tour · HOME
roleplay.context: Partner không nhìn nơi của bạn. Họ phải hình dung được.
steps: Ask 4 questions · give 5 details · use 2 location chunks
roleplay.useful: right outside my bedroom · next to the window · across from my building

roleplay.title: Guided tour · OFFICE

Success: partner can sketch the place

roleplay.title: Guided tour · NEIGHBORHOOD
steps: Opener: Is there a café nearby?
Use There's… · There are… · My area has…
roleplay.useful: within walking distance · a quiet residential area · everything I need nearby

finalTask.text: Work with a partner. Have a 3-minute conversation about your home, office, or neighborhood. Use Is there…? / Are there…? questions and answer with full messages.
Goal: 10+ questions, 10+ full answers. Notice when you use is vs are.
